name: smwmusic-mega-man-battle-network-break-it-down-operation-remix
title: Mega Man Battle Network - Break it Down! ~ Operation! (Remix)
description:
MEGAMAN, ATTACK! *throws pet*

Did a remix of the catchy-as-hell battle theme from Mega Man Battle Network Operation! Wasn't originally planning on doing this song until yesterday, where I was stressed out over a couple things and needed something to distract myself with (Mission Success!!). Otherwise, what more do I have to say about this other than it bangs as much as the other "disco" battle theme from Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga!!!

Great timing too 'cuz the MMBN 20th anniversary is nearby (March 21st).

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C Minor (Custom Pitch)
